issue_context.title: TextEdit's clear() from RMB menu can't be undo
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

28174d5

### System information

W10

### Issue description

When you use "Clear" option from right-click menu in TextEdit node, you can't undo this operation.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Add TextEdit node
2. Run project
3. Type some text
4. Right click -> Clear
5. Try undo
6. No undo

### Minimal reproduction project

_No response_
comments:
Hello @KoBeWi,
Could you please give some more hints which files are relevant? Is there a wiki page for the gui in godot project which you can share?

@theoniko Check `text_edit.cpp`, code related to `MENU_CLEAR` constant.

Right now it will just call `clear()`, which removes undo history. It should preserve the history, but only when clearing from the context menu.
Seems like it was fixed in `2.1` with #16269, but as we hid it from the editor `3.x` via #6640 was never "fixed".
@Paulb23: Would cherry-picking the commit from #16269 to the latest master enought to close this issue?
Would say not as those changes are now irrelevant / can be simplified.

I got stuck on a problem that `clear()` gets called from the class constructor as well, when a lot of data are not initialized. Would it be a better decision to separate this concern from the context menu? Otherwise, is there a good way to differentiate between these two use cases inside the body of the method?

review_comments: No need to call `text.clear()` here as it does the same thing as the other two lines.

`clear()` should also take care of gutters, like in the following test case:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c99c5a1caeafab161daebdde21ccd83ecdc897d5/tests/scene/test_code_edit.h#L144-L152

`text.clear()` becomes helpful here:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c99c5a1caeafab161daebdde21ccd83ecdc897d5/scene/gui/text_edit.cpp#L289-L293

I couldn't find any other exposed functionality of gutters to be used. Is it possible to work around this?
Ahh I see, yeah working around that is going to be awkward compared to leaving it as is.
